$comment: GeoLibre's built-in web-service presets (opengeos/GeoLibre, apps/geolibre-desktop/src/components/layout/add-data/service-library.ts and constants.ts, commit cbc0fb8, 2026-11-08). Copied by hand because they live in TypeScript; scripts/build_catalog.py warns when an endpoint here no longer appears in GeoLibre's source. Left out: the OpenStreetMap basemap (Y-finder has its own basemaps) and the GeoServer demo states layer (a demo server; use Census boundaries instead).

services.title: USGS NAIP Imagery (web map service)
services.provider: USDA Farm Service Agency, served by USGS The National Map
services.description: Latest statewide NAIP aerial imagery, about 0.6 to 1 m, as a quick-look web map service (false-color infrared composite, as set in GeoLibre). Good for seeing vegetation, water and land use before downloading the source tiles from pc:naip.
services.keywords: naip aerial imagery orthophoto infrared false color vegetation sub-meter wms national map

services.title: GEBCO global ocean bathymetry (web map service)
services.provider: GEBCO (General Bathymetric Chart of the Oceans)
services.description: Shaded relief of the latest GEBCO global grid of ocean depth and land elevation, 15 arc-second (about 450 m) cells. Credit GEBCO when you use it.
services.keywords: bathymetry ocean depth seafloor elevation relief coastal marine gebco wms

services.title: NLCD 2021 Land Cover, contiguous US (MRLC web map service)
services.description: National Land Cover Database 2021: 16 classes such as developed intensity, forest, wetlands and cropland at 30 m, drawn with the standard NLCD colors.
services.keywords: land cover land use nlcd impervious developed forest wetland cropland 30 m mrlc wms

services.title: USGS Imagery (The National Map tiles)
services.description: Seamless orthoimagery of the US from The National Map, mostly NAIP-based, about 1 m, as map tiles.
services.keywords: orthoimagery aerial imagery satellite basemap national map usgs tiles

services.title: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2025 mosaic (EOX)
services.provider: EOX IT Services (contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025)
services.description: A cloud-free global mosaic of Sentinel-2 imagery for 2025 at 10 m, as map tiles. CC BY 4.0; credit EOX and Copernicus.
services.keywords: sentinel-2 cloud free mosaic true color satellite imagery 10 m global eox

services.title: USA Major Cities (ArcGIS feature layer)
services.provider: Esri, from U.S. Census Bureau places
services.description: Points for about 4,200 US cities and towns with population, population class, density and state, from an Esri ArcGIS Online feature layer.
services.keywords: cities towns places population urban points census esri feature service
